site.title: Tidewater Support | Round-the-clock IT and customer support
site.description: Tidewater Support runs IT service desks and customer support from Manila, Krakow and Bogota, so a team is on shift in every hour of the day.

data.title: Three hubs, one queue, *every hour covered*
data.lead: Tidewater Support runs IT service desks and customer support from Manila, Krakow and Bogota. Each hub hands open tickets to the next one at the end of its shift.

cards.title: Customer support
cards.text: Email, chat and phone support in your help desk, with a written handoff note at every shift change.

cards.title: IT service desk
cards.text: Password resets, access requests and first-line incident triage for your staff.

cards.title: Spanish support
cards.text: Native Spanish agents for customers in Latin America and Spain.

cards.title: Night coverage
cards.text: Overnight queues for your region answered by the hub that is on its day shift.

data.title: Tell us which hours your queue *goes quiet*
